findings.quoted_text: Upon payment of the first milestone invoice, Client owns all rights in all Deliverables, including Deliverables delivered after that payment.
The aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement is capped at USD 35,000, except that Contractor's indemnification obligations under Section 11 are not subject to this cap.
Fees for Services in progress at the effective termination date are not payable.
Upon payment of the first milestone invoice, Client owns all rights in all Deliverables, including Deliverables delivered after that payment.
findings.explanation: Intellectual property for all deliverables transfers upon payment of only the first milestone, which means the client owns future deliverables before you have been paid for them.
findings.suggested_change: Client shall own all rights in the Deliverables only upon receipt of full and final payment for those Deliverables.

findings.quoted_text: The aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement is capped at USD 35,000, except that Contractor's indemnification obligations under Section 11 are not subject to this cap.
findings.explanation: Your liability is capped, but your indemnification obligations are completely excluded from that cap, exposing you to unlimited financial risk for indemnified claims.
findings.suggested_change: The aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement is capped at USD 35,000, including any indemnification obligations.

findings.quoted_text: Fees for Services in progress at the effective termination date are not payable.
findings.explanation: If the client terminates the contract for convenience, you do not get paid for any work or services currently in progress, leaving you uncompensated for completed efforts.
findings.suggested_change: Client shall pay Contractor for all Services performed and Deliverables created up to the effective date of termination.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before I sign. Specifically:- Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, transferring rights to all deliverables upon payment of only the first milestone leaves future deliverables owned before full payment. I propose that the client shall own all rights in the deliverables only upon receipt of full and final payment for those deliverables.- Regarding the relevant clause on liability, indemnification obligations are excluded from the cap, which exposes me to unlimited financial risk. I propose that the aggregate liability of either party arising from this agreement is capped at USD 35,000, including any indemnification obligations.- Regarding the relevant clause on termination fees, services in progress at termination would not be payable, leaving work uncompensated. I propose that the client shall pay the contractor for all services performed and deliverables created up to the effective date of termination. Thank you for your understanding, and I look forward to finalizing this soon.
